description: Read-only query against the configured public DNSBL/RBL providers; the response lists which ones answered, which could not be measured and which are disabled. Provide either `domain` to resolve and inspect its MX IPv4 addresses or an IPv4 `ip` for a direct check; at least one is required. Returns each provider's listed/clean result, severity, removal metadata, plus unavailable and disabled provider evidence. A provider error code (e.g. Spamhaus 127.255.255.x when the query is refused), a timeout

domain.description: Domain name only, e.g. example.com (no URL, path, or port)

name: intodns__check_blacklist
